target: Jangankan naik gunung, jalan ke warung pun dia malas.
english: Let alone climbing a mountain; he's too lazy even to walk to the food stall.
tip: Jangankan X, Y pun ... = let alone X, even Y: jangankan lari, jalan pun malas.

target: Kami berdua memesan menu yang sama, minumannya saja yang berbeda.
english: The two of us ordered the same dish; only the drinks were different.
tip: X saja yang ... = only X (is what differs): minumannya saja yang berbeda = only the drinks differ.

target: Para penumpang dimohon segera naik ke pesawat melalui pintu tiga.
english: Passengers are requested to board the plane immediately through gate three.
tip: Announcement style: dimohon = 'are requested to' — in speech you'd just hear tolong or harap.

target: Kereta menuju Bandung akan segera berangkat dari jalur dua.
english: The train to Bandung will depart shortly from track two.
tip: Station style: menuju = formal 'bound for' — in conversation people just say ke Bandung.

target: Pesawat tujuan Surabaya mengalami keterlambatan sekitar tiga puluh menit.
english: The flight to Surabaya is experiencing a delay of about thirty minutes.
tip: Announcement verb: mengalami keterlambatan = 'is delayed' — spoken: pesawatnya telat.

target: Mohon perhatian, pintu kereta akan segera ditutup.
english: Attention please, the train doors will close shortly.
tip: Mohon perhatian = 'attention please', the standard announcement opener; mohon is a formal 'please'.

target: Para penumpang dimohon tetap duduk sampai pesawat berhenti dengan sempurna.
english: Passengers are requested to remain seated until the plane has stopped completely.
tip: Cabin formula: berhenti dengan sempurna = 'come to a complete stop' — spoken: benar-benar berhenti.

target: Kami mohon maaf atas keterlambatan kereta ini.
english: We apologize for the delay of this train.
tip: Official apology: kami mohon maaf atas ... — spoken: maaf ya, keretanya telat.

target: Para penumpang tujuan Yogyakarta dipersilakan menuju pintu keberangkatan lima.
english: Passengers bound for Yogyakarta are invited to proceed to departure gate five.
tip: dipersilakan = formal 'are invited to' — everyday version: silakan ke pintu lima.

target: Harap tidak meninggalkan barang bawaan Anda tanpa pengawasan.
english: Please do not leave your luggage unattended.
tip: harap = formal 'please' of signs and announcements — softer than dilarang, stiffer than tolong.

target: Kereta terakhir menuju Bogor berangkat pukul sebelas malam.
english: The last train to Bogor departs at eleven at night.
tip: pukul sebelas = formal clock time in announcements — in conversation everyone says jam sebelas.

target: Penumpang yang membawa anak kecil dipersilakan naik terlebih dahulu.
english: Passengers with small children are invited to board first.
tip: terlebih dahulu = formal 'first, beforehand' — spoken Indonesian says duluan or lebih dulu.

target: Mohon periksa kembali barang bawaan Anda sebelum turun dari kereta.
english: Please check your belongings again before getting off the train.
tip: barang bawaan = official 'belongings, luggage' — casually people just say barang or tas.

target: Demi keselamatan bersama, penumpang dilarang bersandar pada pintu.
english: For everyone's safety, passengers are forbidden to lean on the doors.
tip: Demi is a formal 'for the sake of': demi keselamatan bersama = for our shared safety. Announcements and oaths use it; casual speech just says untuk.

target: Pesawat dari Denpasar telah mendarat di terminal dua.
english: The plane from Denpasar has landed at terminal two.
tip: telah = the formal 'sudah' of announcements and news — in speech, always sudah.

target: Perjalanan kereta ini akan memakan waktu sekitar dua jam.
english: This train journey will take about two hours.
tip: memakan waktu = formal 'to take (time)' — spoken: perjalanannya kira-kira dua jam.

target: Para penumpang dimohon mempersiapkan tiket untuk diperiksa petugas.
english: Passengers are requested to have their tickets ready to be checked by the officer.
tip: mempersiapkan = formal menyiapkan — announcements love memper- verbs; spoken: siapkan tiketnya.

target: Karena cuaca buruk, semua penerbangan sore ini ditunda.
english: Due to bad weather, all flights this afternoon are postponed.
tip: Announcement passive: ditunda = 'are postponed' — a staff member would say diundur.

target: Penumpang transit dimohon menunggu di ruang tunggu utama.
english: Transit passengers are requested to wait in the main waiting lounge.
tip: ruang tunggu = 'waiting lounge' — official signage; in speech: tempat nunggu.

target: Pengumuman ini juga berlaku untuk penumpang kelas ekonomi.
english: This announcement also applies to economy class passengers.
tip: berlaku = formal 'applies, is valid' — you will see it on tickets, rules and notices everywhere.

target: Para penumpang yang terhormat, selamat datang di Stasiun Gambir.
english: Dear passengers, welcome to Gambir Station.
tip: yang terhormat = 'esteemed, dear' — the polite address of announcements and letters.

target: Anak-anak harap selalu didampingi oleh orang tua selama perjalanan.
english: Children should always be accompanied by their parents during the journey.
tip: didampingi = formal 'be accompanied' — spoken: anaknya harus sama orang tuanya.

target: Nomor penerbangan Anda dapat dilihat pada layar informasi.
english: Your flight number can be seen on the information screen.
tip: In announcements dapat = 'can' — in conversation this is always bisa: bisa dilihat.

target: Kepada seluruh penumpang, kami ucapkan selamat jalan dan terima kasih.
english: To all passengers, we bid you a good journey and thank you.
tip: kami ucapkan = ceremonial 'we express' — spoken: makasih ya, hati-hati di jalan.

target: Dengan hormat, kami sampaikan jadwal rapat bulan depan.
english: Dear Sir or Madam, we hereby convey next month's meeting schedule.
tip: Dengan hormat = 'Dear Sir/Madam', the fixed opener of every official Indonesian letter.

target: Bersama surat ini kami lampirkan daftar harga terbaru.
english: With this letter we attach the latest price list.
tip: bersama surat ini = 'enclosed with this letter' — pure letter language, never spoken.

target: Atas perhatian Bapak, kami ucapkan terima kasih.
english: For your attention, Sir, we express our thanks.
tip: Atas perhatian ... terima kasih = the fixed letter closer, 'thank you for your attention'.

target: Hormat kami, bagian pemasaran PT Maju Bersama.
english: Yours faithfully, the marketing department of PT Maju Bersama.
tip: Hormat kami = 'yours faithfully' — the letter sign-off from a team or company.

target: Saya menulis surat ini untuk mengajukan permohonan cuti.
english: I am writing this letter to submit a leave request.
tip: mengajukan permohonan = 'to submit a request' — office language; spoken: minta cuti.

target: Dengan ini saya mengajukan pengunduran diri dari jabatan saya.
english: I hereby submit my resignation from my position.
tip: dengan ini = 'hereby' — a signal of formal writing; nobody says it out loud.
